claims.statement: Cultural transmission acts as a domain-general mechanism enabling agents to acquire behavioral dispositions and information in real-time.

support.explanation: Identifies cultural transmission as a foundational mechanism for real-time information acquisition in multi-agent environments.

review.alternative: Preferences might fluctuate randomly without locking into stable path-dependent states.

claims.statement: Historical interaction sequences create stable constraints on future behavior, forming path-dependent preference structures.
